question:
In the given figure, AB || QP. AB = x, PQ = x + 10. RB = (x)/(2), BP = x + 1. Find PQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b67c8a8a0576d12673f793606c1a57ae70a60cc7bcbc21d9cf117feef95bcf8d.png]
solution:
Given:

AB ∥ QP

AB = x

PQ = x + 10,

RB = (x)/(2)

BP = x + 1

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd455643d0e2fdaa62f635956d5734ceae28730c849fc35939e4047c4bcb711b.png] 

In triangle RQP and triangle RAB 

We have,

AB ∥ QP

 angle1=angle3\ angle2=angle4 {corresponding angles}

 angle R=angle R {common}

So, by AAA these two triangles are similar

Thus, by Properties of similar triangles

{RBover RP}={ABover QP}

Calculation:

We have, {RBover RP}={ABover QP}

Substituting the values, we get,

(frac{x)/(2)}{(x+1 + x/2)}={xover(x+10)}

(x)/((3x+2))={xover(x+10)}

x + 10 = 3x + 2

2x = 8

x = 4

Since, PQ = x + 10

PQ = 4 + 10 = 14 units

Hence, the required answer is '14' units'.
